raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 9
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner conflated the 1989 handmade/test-run Icehouse sets with the later product “Icehouse: The Martian Chess Set,” incorrectly stating the earliest edition year as 1989 (and implying Looney Labs), despite sources (e.g., BoardGameGeek) indicating the Martian Chess Set dates to 1999. This was the first factual error, though it did not change the correct final comparison that Icehouse pieces predate Kill Doctor Lucky (1996).
